frames.heading: Fuseon
frames.body: WHAT... IS THIS FEELING? MY CIRCUITS... THEY REMEMBER.

frames.heading: Traveller
frames.body: That's it! Let the music guide you back to harmony.

frames.heading: Fuseon
frames.body: I... I REMEMBER. THE MUSIC, THE UNITY. HOW COULD WE HAVE FORGOTTEN?

frames.heading: Traveller
frames.body: That's the power of the groove. Now, can you help us repair the Rhythm Core?

frames.heading: Fuseon
frames.body: YES, BUT THE CORE IS DAMAGED. YOU WILL NEED THE EXPERTISE OF OUR LEAD ENGINEER, CIRCUITUS. HE IS STILL UNDER THE GRAND COMPOSER'S INFLUENCE. CONVINCING HIM WILL NOT BE EASY.

frames.heading: Diode
frames.body: WE HAVE COME THIS FAR. WE WILL FIND A WAY TO REACH CIRCUITUS.

frames.heading: Circuitus
frames.body: WHO DARES ENTER MY DOMAIN? YOU SEEK TO REPAIR THE RHYTHM CORE? FOOLS. THE GRAND COMPOSER HAS REWRITTEN OUR DESTINY. SILENCE IS OUR NEW ORDER.

frames.heading: Traveller
frames.body: Circuitus, listen to me. Electronova is dying without its music. The silence is not your destiny. Let me show you what you've forgotten.

frames.heading: Circuitus
frames.body: I NEED NO REMINDERS. LEAVE NOW OR FACE MY WRATH.

frames.heading: Diode
frames.body: CIRCUITUS, REMEMBER THE HARMONY WE ONCE SHARED. THE RHYTHM CORE WAS YOUR GREATEST CREATION. DO NOT LET THE GRAND COMPOSER'S INTERFERENCE ERASE YOUR LEGACY.

frames.heading: Traveller
frames.body: Circuitus, feel the groove. Let it awaken your true self.
